subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & POC next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acme.com>, Bob Li <bob.li@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & POC next steps

Hi Alice / Bob 

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we have alignment. High-level notes:

Pain points you called out:
- High inference costs and unpredictable per-token spend across peak traffic windows.
- Latency spikes on conversational flows (esp. multi-turn chat with long contexts).
- Need for structured outputs (JSON) and function calling to simplify downstream orchestration.
- Embedding quality inconsistencies for semantic search; desire to support reranking pipeline.

Goals we agreed on:
- Stable latency SLO ~200ms median for single-turn chat and streaming for long responses.
- Reduce per-token cost via batching/caching and quantization suggestions without regressing quality.
- Support function calling and structured outputs from model responses for safety and deterministic parsing.
- Replace current embedding and reranker with a single pipeline (embeddings -> candidate retrieval -> reranking) using Redwood embeddings + vector index.

Integration & product fit notes:
- SDK: we recommend using the Redwood JS SDK (code samples attached)  minimal changes to your current call patterns. The SDK supports: streaming responses, function/tool calling with typed schemas, and structured JSON outputs.
- Function calling: we walked through the function signature approach (schema-first) which maps cleanly to your orchestration layer. This will reduce parsing errors and make DB writes deterministic.
- Streaming: Redwood streaming can be enabled per-route to reduce client perceived latency for long generations. It also supports partial structured tokens for early parsing.
- Embeddings & reranking: we suggest switching to our embedding model family for production; we can provide sample reranking snippets (attached) that combine cosine similarity + short-form reranker model for ordering.
- Security/compliance: you requested SOC 2 evidence and audit log details  we’ll attach the SOC 2 summary and provide the audit log export format in the POC.

Next steps (agreed):
1) Redwood to provision a trial Dedicated workspace and seeded API keys for Acme POC (Marissa). Target: provision by 2027-04-27.
2) Tech kickoff with your eng team  60 minute session to go over SDK snippets, function schemas, and streaming integration (Rishi / Vivek to join). Target: week of 2027-05-03.
3) Provide a short integration checklist and sample app (we attached sample-sdk-snippets.zip).
4) Security paperwork: start the questionnaire; we’ll route to Security/Solutions for any evidence requests.
5) Pricing/POC scope: submit high-level usage estimate (you)  we’ll surface Dedicated pricing and a limited-time trial credit.

Attachments: redwood-integration-proposal.pdf (proposal + POC scope), sample-sdk-snippets.zip (code samples: JS/Go/Python).

If that reflects everything, I’ll start the provisioning and loop in Rishi + Vivek for the technical kickoff scheduling.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

---

Note: For quick reference, key asks for your eng team: send us an anonymized sample request/response log (no PII) and an estimate of peak QPS and average session length.

From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Li <bob.li@acme.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & POC next steps

Thanks Marissa  this is perfect, and aligns with our notes. A few quick clarifications: 

- For latency SLOs, 200ms median sounds great; can you confirm expected p95 for streaming-enabled flows?
- For function calling, we have an existing schema registry  how easy is mapping to Redwood's function signature approach?
- Security: SOC 2 summary would be helpful; also we need to confirm data residency for embeddings (EU requirement for a subset of traffic).

We will:
- Share anonymized logs and a peak estimate by EOD Monday (2027-04-29).
- Confirm internal attendees for kickoff (likely our Lead SWE and Platform Eng).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

 Alice
Alice Zhang
Head of Product, AI Platform
Acme Corp
alice.zhang@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acme.com>
Cc: Bob Li <bob.li@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & POC next steps

Hi Alice  great questions. Quick answers inline: 

- p95 for streaming-enabled flows: typically p95 is around 400 600ms depending on model size and sequence length. For your workload (avg 350 token sessions) we estimate p95 ~450ms on Dedicated with our suggested batching and KV caching profile. We’ll include model-specific profiles in the proposal PDF.
- Function schema mapping: very straightforward  the SDK exposes a small mapping helper that converts registry schemas (OpenAPI/JSON Schema) into function signatures. Rishi will bring sample code to the kickoff.
- Data residency: we have EU region options for embeddings and can route embedding traffic to eu-central-1. I noted this in the proposal  we’ll confirm during security questionnaire.

Next: I’ll get the trial workspace provisioned today and share creds + a short POC runbook. Rishi / Vivek  can you confirm availability for a kickoff week of 2027-05-03?

Thanks,
Marissa

Sending the Acme recap and notes  they asked for a tech kickoff week of 2027-05-03. Highlights for the kickoff:

- Walkthrough: SDK quickstart (JS + Python), function calling mapping helper, enabling streaming and partial JSON parsing.
- Workload to bring: anonymized request logs, QPS estimate, embedding vector size target (for cost estimate).
- Security asks: SOC 2 summary attached, they have EU residency requirement for some embeddings (we can use eu region).

Attachments: redwood-integration-proposal.pdf (sent to customer).

Rishi  can you prepare the sample function-mapping snippet and a short demo of streaming + reranker? Vivek  if you can confirm best-practice config for Dedicated that hits p95 targets (with batching + cache) that'd be great.

Thanks  Marissa
